theorems.name: Submission.dohr_eb_ehs_differentiated_el
theorems.statement: ∀ n ℓ : ℕ, ∀ (Ψ : (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) → ℝ) (U : Set (Rn n)) (u g : Rn n → Rn ℓ), IsOpen U → ContDiff ℝ 2 Ψ → ContDiffOn ℝ 2 u U → ContinuousOn g U → (∀ φ : Rn n → Rn ℓ, ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → HasCompactSupport φ → tsupport φ ⊆ U → ∫ x in U, fderiv ℝ Ψ (fderiv ℝ u x) (fderiv ℝ φ x) = -∫ x in U, inner ℝ (φ x) (g x)) → ∀ (e : Rn n) (ζ : Rn n → Rn ℓ), ContDiff ℝ 1 ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ U → ∫ x in U, fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ Ψ) (fderiv ℝ u x) (fderiv ℝ (fun z => fderiv ℝ u z e) x) (fderiv ℝ ζ x) = ∫ x in U, inner ℝ (g x) (fderiv ℝ ζ x e)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
